topics.title: Machine learning for polymer simulation
topics.paragraph: Compared preliminary polymer-density estimates from MACE simulations with reference data. Investigated GPU-memory limitations in UMA / FAIR-Chem calculations and compared runtime, GPU memory use, and GPU-hours across selected MACE runs.

topics.title: Representation learning for molecular dynamics
topics.paragraph: Studied JEPA-based representations for coarse-grained polymers and atomistic water. In the water experiments, used pretrained MACE features and atomic velocities to predict short-time atomic displacements, and compared temporal JEPA training with direct supervision.

courseProjects.paragraph: Adapted an existing YOLOv1-style detector with a pretrained ResNet-18 backbone for lane and traffic-object detection in BDD100K driving scenes. Used an unseen Shenzhen highway video for qualitative evaluation and analyzed errors involving reflections, lane geometry, and traffic signs.
